verdicts.explanation: The h-LiBH4 value (~10−3 S cm-1 at 120 °C) is quoted in the Introduction as background from the Matsuo et al. work (ref. 4). This paper does not measure conductivity, so literature_cited is correct and the temperature matches.
The o-LiBH4 value of 9.5 × 10−9 ± 2 × 10−9 S cm-1 at 30 °C is cited to ref. 5 in the Introduction, so literature_cited is correct. The material, unit and temperature match the paper.

The LiBH4-LiI hexagonal solid solution with 25 mol.% LiI and its ~10−4 S cm-1 at 30 °C value come from the literature-review sentence citing refs. 10–12. Origin, material and temperature are right, and the dopant I is correct.

verdicts.explanation: The sentence giving ~10−5 S cm-1 for h-Li(BH4)0.7(Br)0.3 is explicitly framed as room-temperature conductivity, so the temperature is not absent from the paper and the null value is not supported. The value and origin (ref. 12) are otherwise right.
